folds.title: Git
points: **Git** keeps a history of your project.
Each **commit** is a save point you can return to.
It is the best undo button for anything Claude changes.

folds.title: Before a big task
points: If Claude goes the wrong way, compare to that clean save point and go back to it.
A **branch** lets you try something without touching the main copy.

folds.title: Git in plain language

chat.claude: I edited two files: the login page and its test.

chat.you: Write a commit message for it.

chat.claude: "Fix the login error message and add a test." Shall I commit?

folds.note: Read what it proposes before you approve.

folds.title: Checkpoints
points: Claude Code keeps **checkpoints** of files it edits.
They are quick session undo, not a replacement for git.

folds.title: What checkpoints miss
points: Files changed only by shell commands.
Git catches those, so commit often.

folds.prompt: Checkpoint or git? Tap the basket.
